author: Claude (Cloudreach Meshy generation worker), owner-authorized Meshy use (Standing owner direction 1, 15 Oct 2026)
workflow: agent-drafted multi-view concept from repo references (Meshy image-to-image nano-banana-pro) -> Meshy multi-image-to-3d (latest, quad remesh, PBR)
target_size_m: 30 m wide x 12 m deep x 18 m tall cliff-edge module incl. ~8 m tapering jagged underside

scale_normalisation.method: lossless: GLB scene roots wrapped in node 'metres_root' with uniform scale + translation; base at y=0, footprint centred on x/z

concepts.prompt: Cliff-edge terrain module from a floating sky island: a rectangular chunk 30 metres wide, 12 metres deep and 18 metres tall. Flat grassy top surface with a soft grass lip overhanging the edge. The front face is a near-vertical stratified limestone cliff with stacked horizontal beds and mossy ledges. Below the main face the underside tapers into jagged hanging rock points reaching about 8 metres further down, like the underside of a floating island. Same rock language as the references. Stylised-realism game asset in the Palworld / Animo art style, single isolated object on a plain neutral background, even soft daylight, no cast background, no people. Materials: pale warm-grey weathered limestone (#9a8f80 to #b8ad9c, never pure white) with clearly stacked horizontal sedimentary strata and soft moss on the ledges; where present, slate-blue roof tile (#3d4a66), honey-coloured timber, cream plaster, royal-blue banner fabric with a small gold accent. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon anywhere. Flat ground contact at the base.

visual_verdict: Good: flat grass top, stratified face, jagged hanging underside. Meshy proportions are near-cubic: at 30 m wide (long axis is Z, not X) it is ~31 m tall and ~18 m deep, so it is taller/deeper than the 30x12x18 brief; non-uniform scale or a deeper terrain bury will be needed.
integration_flag: OFF - candidate only; stays flag-off until its scene passes code-blind judging
palette_check: no red/oxblood requested or observed; blue banners/roofs only
